title: TimesNet: Periodicity-aware convolutional models are data-efficient on ETTh1, Weather
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using TimesNet, a 2D-convolutional periodicity-aware model. On ETTh1, Weather, at horizon 336, Periodicity-aware convolutional models are data-efficient on ETTh1, Weather. TimesNet outperforms transformer baselines when trained on 5% of the data on ETTh1. We discuss two limitations: Reported gains use a single held-out split; results across seeds vary by more than the headline MSE difference. Computational cost is reported for a single input length; scaling behaviour is not measured. Future work should address studying performance under explicit train/test distribution shift. and pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer. [SEED-FIXTURE — not a real publication].
